veranderings.rede: 'Oor 'n lang tyd' echoes English 'over a long time'; 'tydperk' reads more naturally after 'oor' and keeps the meaning.

veranderings.voor: op die bodem is die eerste laag
veranderings.na: op die bodem vorm die eerste laag
veranderings.rede: 'Vorm' is the more natural verb for mud and sand that make up a layer, and the meaning stays the same.
